_comment: EVERYTHING THE UI SAYS ABOUT *YOUR* CORPUS LIVES IN THIS FILE. Edit it and rebuild the frontend -- no component code needs touching. The values shipped here describe the library this system was built for; replace them with your own. Cyrillic is written as escape sequences so the file survives toolchains that read it as cp1252, but plain UTF-8 works too.

overview.intro: A CRAG-powered (Corrective RAG) study and reference assistant built for my wife -- a professional German-Russian translator. It answers grammar and vocabulary questions in German or Russian and backs every claim with [book, page] citations from her own personal library.
